headerDisplay: Controls Stadler Form Noah / Noah Pro humidifiers locally over your LAN using the Tuya protocol. You need each device's Tuya **Device ID** and **Local Key** — see the README for how to obtain them.
footerDisplay: Having trouble? Enable Homebridge debug mode (-D) and check the log for `[Noah]` lines.

name.title: Name
name.description: Name shown in the Home app.

key.title: Tuya Local Key
key.description: 16-character local key. Changes if you re-pair the device in the Stadler Form / Smart Life app.

ip.title: IP Address
ip.description: Optional. Leave blank to discover the device by UDP broadcast on the local network. Set this if Homebridge runs in a different subnet or inside Docker without host networking.

version.title: Tuya Protocol Version
version.description: Auto-detect requires UDP discovery to work. If you set a fixed IP you should also set the version.

pollInterval.title: Poll Interval (seconds)
pollInterval.description: How often to request full state from the device. The device also pushes changes instantly; this is a safety net.

exposeFanControl.title: Expose fan speed as a separate fan
exposeFanControl.description: The Home app hides fan speed on humidifier accessories. Enable to add a Fan tile with a 5-step speed slider (power is shared with the humidifier).

exposeDisplayLight.title: Expose display brightness as a light
exposeDisplayLight.description: Adds a dimmable light tile (Off / 50% / 100%) that controls the LED display. Note: some firmware reverts this setting on its own.

exposeWaterTankSensor.title: Expose water-tank-empty as a contact sensor
exposeWaterTankSensor.description: Adds a contact sensor that opens when the tank is empty, useful for notifications and automations.

homekitRevision.title: HomeKit accessory revision
homekitRevision.description: Leave at 0. Increase by one to re-publish this device as a brand-new accessory, which forces the Home app to discard all cached properties (slider ranges etc.). The accessory will need to be assigned to its room again and any scenes/automations using it re-created.

filterLifeIsUsed.title: Filter life datapoint reports % used
filterLifeIsUsed.description: Enable if the Filter Life shown in Home is the inverse of what the Stadler Form app shows (the device reports % consumed rather than % remaining).
